reuse.why: Replaces both existing inline holiday checks with one new isHoliday helper and touches nothing else.

duplication.why: The two copies of the holiday test become one function; the remaining `isWeekend || isHoliday` pairing predates the change.

placement.why: isHoliday lives in shared/schedules.ts next to its only two consumers, getNextDate and getDateWithWeekendRule.

scope.why: Only the holiday matcher and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Holiday interpretation now has a single definition, so the next format change is made once.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; both holiday consumers call isHoliday

disguised_duplication.where: none; the previous duplicated holidays.includes checks are removed in favour of isHoliday
